$comment: Zero Unjustified Dependencies. Every runtime dependency must be listed here with its justification. scripts/ci/check-deps.mjs fails CI when package.json drifts from this file.

runtime.@prisma/client: Database access layer; the only ORM.
runtime.next-auth: Session and credential authentication (JWT strategy, no adapter).
runtime.bcryptjs: Password hashing for HR and platform-admin accounts; pure JS, no native build.
runtime.nodemailer: SMTP delivery for invitations and notifications using each tenant's own server.
runtime.lucide-react: Icon set shipped as local SVG components; no network requests.
runtime.tailwind-merge: Conflict-safe Tailwind class merging inside cn(); a naive join is not conflict-safe.
